entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • FreeBSD: ReceiveMessageFromAsync returns IPPacketInformation.Interface == 0 for IPv4 limited broadcast #132360
  • ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService hangs #132359
  • XmlSerializer: reflection-based reader cannot deserialize into any readonly collection field #132357
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Fixer failed #132355
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner failed #132354
  • SslStream on Unix leaks one X509 per intermediate per connection: AddExtraChainCertificates assumes add0 but CryptoNative_SslAddExtraChainCert is add1 #132350

Closed

  • ResourceManager not threadsafe when case insensitive keys are used #80790
    Future
  • System.Resources.Extensions.Tests.PreserializedResourceWriterTests.TestResourceManagerIsSafeForConcurrentAccessAndEnumeration(useEnumeratorEntry: False) [FAIL] #127992
  • NativeAOT deadlock: FindReferenceTargetsCallback cctor allocates during GC callout (RestrictedCallouts) — WinUI 3 UI hang #132352
  • Uri.TryUnescapeDataString throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException #128608
    11.0.0
  • Graphics.DrawString in x64 applications sometimes generates non-identical images #122566
    Future
  • [API Proposal]: EditorBrowsableState for within a single solution #123398
    Future
  • Add async APIs to System.ComponentModel for type conversion and validation #121536
  • TypeConverter inconsistencies #118724
    Future
  • [Perf] Linux/arm64: 27 Regressions on 3/7/2026 4:46:53 AM +00:00 #125504
    Future
  • [API Proposal]: JavaScriptEncoder.CreateUnsafe(ReadOnlyMemory<UnicodeRange>) method #119551
    11.0.0
  • Arm64 minimum hardware requirements excludes some Windows 10 IoT supported CPUs #132340

PullRequests

Created

  • Add ILVerify option to validate all metadata references #132362
    area-Tools-ILVerification, community-contribution
  • JIT: Add guarded devirtualization support for generic virtual methods #132361
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Arm64: opportunistically light up LSE atomics for NativeAOT #132358
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, 12.0.0
  • Support deserializing read-only collections in XmlSerializer via [CollectionBuilder] #132356
    area-Serialization
  • Expose Composite ML-DSA CNG identifiers #132353
    area-System.Security
  • Fix X509 reference leak in SslStream extra chain certificates on Unix #132351
    area-System.Security, community-contribution

Merged

  • Skip GitHub_130545 on NativeAOT #132342
    area-TypeSystem-coreclr
  • Partition the ComWrappers RCW cache into per-processor buckets #132033
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices, tenet-performance, community-contribution
  • Restore Windows Arm64 support for CPUs without LSE #132345
    area-VM-coreclr
  • [wasm] Encode struct alignment in thunk signatures #132248
    area-ReadyToRun
  • Add locking for cDAC APIs #132302
    area-Diagnostics-cdac

Updated

  • Reduce the GC handle cost of every RCW in ComWrappers #132040
    tenet-performance, area-Interop-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Fix PointConverter's leading white-space handling #130692
    area-System.ComponentModel, community-contribution
  • Update guidelines for C++ standard library usage and build against libc++ w/ libstdc++ ABI for linux arm/arm64/x64 #132347
    area-Infrastructure
  • Make DegreesToRadians and RadiansToDegrees correctly rounded #132096
    area-System.Numerics
  • Inline GC handle write barrier #132245
    area-GC-coreclr
  • Support devirtualization for virtual methods that require runtime lookups #129806
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Add support for array interface devirtualization in R2R #131265
    area-ReadyToRun, linkable-framework
  • fix shutdown tests #129853
    area-Extensions-Hosting
  • Ensure BackgroundService invokes ExecuteAsync after start #132241
    area-Extensions-Hosting
  • Remove multi-level lookup completely #132335
    area-Host, 12.0.0
  • Add proposal doc for specifying load context for native hosting #132247
    area-Host, 12.0.0
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #132175
    area-codeflow
  • [System.Configuration] Fix settings upgrade on iOS and tvOS #132283
    area-System.Configuration, os-ios
  • Implement AES-KW #132349
    area-System.Security, cryptographic-docs-impact
  • Fix null return condition in NullableConverter<T>.OnTryRead #129220
    area-System.Text.Json
